simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַעֲנָה (H4618) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַעֲנָה (maʻănâh) means a furrow First listed occurrence: 1Sam 14 14.

definitions.full: H4618. maanah מַעֲנָה noun feminine place for task (?), specifically field for ploughing : — plural suffix לְמַעֲנוֺתָם Psa 129:3 Kt they have extended their ploughing-grounds (Qr מַעֲנִיתָם ); singular מַעֲנָה only 1Sam 14:14 , where text corrupt and meaning dubious see Commentaries מַעֲנִית Psa 129:3 Qr see foregoing.
definitions.rootNote: from 6031 , in the sense of depression or tilling;
